Name: KTG's Slime Hutch Interior
Author: KasualTheGamer
Description:
[center][img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/ktgs-slime-hutch-interior.png[/img][/center]

I got bored with the regular slime hutch interior, and going in there feels like a chore to me, so I made this to make the interior more fun.

This map provides more room in the Slime Hutch, an auto-fenced area where you can corral your slimes, and fishing that matches the town and the mountain area fishing, plus Slimejacks and Midnight Carp felt appropriate.

[center][/center][img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/dependencies.png[/img]

You must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] v 2.7 or later installed for this map to properly load. This is a content pack for Content Patcher.

[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/config-options.png[/img]

SMAPI will generate a config file that looks like the below.

[code]﻿{
    "EnableFishing": "true",
    "NoSpoilers": "true"
}
[/code]
I suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to allow managing the options in game.

[b]EnableFishing [/b]can take either [b]true [/b]or [b]false [/b]values. [b]True[/b] lets you fish in the stream inside the Slime Hutch. [b]False[/b] disables fishing in the Slime Hutch.

[b]EnableFishing[/b] has to be set to [b]true[/b] for the [b]NoSpoilers[/b] option to have any affect. It, likewise, takes either [b]true[/b] or [b]false[/b] values, and when [b]true[/b] limits fishing to just the fish that are can be fished up in the Town or the Mountain map [b][i]until[/i][/b] the current player visits the map where Slime Jacks spawn. When [b]false[/b] and [b]EnableFishing[/b] is [b]true[/b], Slimejacks can be fished up at all times, and Midnight Carp can be caught even in Spring or Summer, though still only between 10 PM and 2 AM.

[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/compatibility.png[/img]

This mod only changes the interior layout map of the Slime Hutch, which does involve an update to Data/Buildings/Slime Hutch to get the Slime Incubator to spawn in a different location. It uses base game assets, so if you're using a recolor mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] those changes will affect the look of this map.

This mod will conflict with any other mod that replaces the Slime Hutch interior.

[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/translations.png[/img]

The only thing to translate is the GMCM config menu.

Beta versions of this mod will be on [url=https://github.com/KasualTheGamer/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior]GitHub[/url].

If you think you can do better than me, you're probably right. I did not create any image assets for this mod (just arranged the vanilla tiles on a new map), so there's nothing for me to get flaffed over someone using. Have fun, and send me a link to what you make, please.
